name: Isosorbide dinitrate
mechanism: NO donor — venodilation and preload reduction
dosing: Typical dosing varies by formulation and indication; follow product guidance
contraindications: Concurrent phosphodiesterase-5 (PDE5) inhibitor use (severe hypotension risk), marked hypotension, severe anaemia, increased intracranial pressure; avoid where systemic hypotension is problematic
interactions: Strong interaction with PDE5 inhibitors (profound hypotension); additive hypotensive effects with other vasodilators; alcohol may exacerbate hypotension
monitoring: Measure blood pressure and heart rate before and after dose initiation and with dose changes; monitor symptom relief and tolerance to headaches
pregnancy: Use in pregnancy only if essential and after specialist discussion—short-term use may be considered for acute symptom relief
sideEffects: Common: headache, flushing, hypotension; less common: reflex tachycardia; long-term tolerance may develop
clinicalPearls: Short-acting nitrate useful for acute angina or symptomatic relief; isosorbide mononitrate (ISMN) is preferred for chronic prophylaxis due to longer duration; ensure nitrate-free interval to reduce tolerance
indication: Relief of acute angina symptoms and selected use for symptom relief in acute heart failure settings (e.g., pulmonary oedema)
